name: Fourier Splatting Primitive
definition: A planar primitive for radiance field rendering that replaces the fixed Gaussian falloff with a Fourier-encoded boundary, allowing arbitrary closed shapes and inherent scalability via coefficient truncation.
summary: A Fourier Splatting Primitive is a planar surfel using Fourier series boundaries for arbitrary shapes, offering inherent scalability via runtime coefficient truncation unlike fixed Gaussian splats.
